decoder.name: I2S skew
decoder.description: Measures the time skew (delta) between LRC frames on two independent I2S buses. Probes BCLK, LRC (WS), and DIN on both boards to decode frames and compute inter-board timing offset at sub-sample precision.

channels.name: LRC 1
channels.desc: Word select / left-right clock, board A

channels.name: LRC 2
channels.desc: Word select / left-right clock, board B

options.name: Bit width
options.desc: I2S slot width in bits (auto if 0)

options.name: Sample rate Hz
options.desc: Audio sample rate for display calculations

outputs.name: Skew measurements
outputs.desc: Time delta (ns) between matched LRC frames on the two boards
